details: Hopes for a lasting peace deal between the US and Iran have diminished after US President Donald Trump stated the ceasefire was on "massive life support" following Iran's "unacceptable" response to a US peace proposal. This has renewed concerns about disruptions in the crucial Strait of Hormuz, causing crude oil prices to surge. The escalating tensions contribute to global market uncertainty and fears of sustained inflationary pressures.
title: Trump: Iran Ceasefire on "Life Support," Oil Prices Climb Amid Hormuz Tensions
